summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @or-sdk/event-manager 1.1.5 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-cjs blob (hex-numeric identifiers, rotated string-array cipher via functions like WV8StW over the `n7gIxM` array) that is not referenced by the package's declared `main`/`module` entrypoints and has no discernible relationship to an event-manager SDK. The fetch-and-execute occurs at `npm install` time, running an opaque payload under a runtime staged specifically to execute it — bypassing Node-based supply-chain inspection. The alternate-runtime staging plus install-time execution of an obfuscated bundled blob unrelated to the package's advertised purpose is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
